resources.string: Use all travel above the dead zone to control your output range. Example: 5% dead zone → 20–50% output. Reconnect the stream after changes.
Sends zero through this input radius. Remaining travel is remapped across the entire output range. 0% disables the client dead zone.
Output jumps to this radius just beyond the dead zone, then rises toward maximum. Use this to overcome a dead zone built into a game. If minimum exceeds maximum, maximum is used.
Output radius at full tilt. 50% caps output at half strength, including diagonals. 0% disables this stick. Minimum is capped at this value.
